platform: KUTX On-Air Rotation and Electronic Specialty Submission
manual_review_reason: KUTX accepts finished music through a purpose-specific Music Director email and permits separate pitching to relevant specialty shows. A human must approve the final email, confirm the release is mastered and FCC-clean, provide a working streaming link and WAV download, select the most relevant route, and avoid invitation-only or paid event-promotion workflows.

platform: Fresh On The Net Weekly Listening Post Submission
manual_review_reason: Fresh On The Net opens its first-party inbox only from Monday until 200 tracks are received or Wednesday evening, and it was closed during verification. A human must return during an open window, inspect the live form and any runtime controls, confirm the track is public worldwide and has not been submitted before, verify non-AI origin and eligibility, and complete the submission without attempting to influence community voting.

WRIR explicitly directs music submissions to its Music Department, but the first-party email address is protected in passive extraction. A human must open the official contact page, use the displayed authorized address without decoding or guessing it programmatically, confirm current submission expectations and suitable programming, prepare the pitch, and send it manually.
